create.name: Kelly Smith
create.bio:
Kelly Smith is a Minneapolis-based yoga and meditation teacher and teacher trainer, and the founder of the online school Yoga For You. She first came to yoga as a teenager, as cross-training for sport, and signed up for her first teacher training straight after college. Since then she has studied a wide range of yoga and meditation styles and holds the E-RYT 500 and YACEP designations with Yoga Alliance. Her own leaning is towards the quieter practices: seated meditation, yoga nidra, restorative yoga and slow, mindful flows.

She is best known as the host of Mindful in Minutes, a podcast of short guided meditations that she began in 2017 and still records at home, now with several hundred episodes, and she also hosts Meditation Mama for parents. Through Yoga For You she runs self-paced online trainings for people who want to teach meditation or yoga nidra, a short course on writing and recording guided meditations, a four-week mentorship for teachers and podcasters, and private sessions over Zoom. She has written two books for Fair Winds Press, leads small-group retreats with guest co-hosts in places such as Bayfield, Wisconsin and Banff, and encourages each student to find the style that suits them rather than follow one method.

courses.title: 40 Hour Meditation Teacher Training
courses.description: A self-paced online training in ten modules covering the history and foundations of meditation, several styles from breath and present-moment awareness onwards, and how to guide individuals and groups. It counts for 40 continuing education hours with Yoga Alliance.

courses.title: 25 Hour Yoga Nidra Teacher Training
courses.description: An online course in eight modules on the roots and structure of yoga nidra, including the koshas and sankalpa, with guidance on writing your own scripts and leading sessions. It counts for 25 continuing education hours with Yoga Alliance.

courses.title: Master Guided Meditations
courses.description: A short course for teachers who want to write, record at home and share their first guided meditation, drawing on what Kelly has learned from years of making her podcast.

courses.title: Four-week mentorship with Kelly Smith
courses.description: A tailored one-to-one programme for yoga and meditation teachers, podcasters and wellness professionals, opening with a long strategy call and followed by weekly calls, assignments and email support, with check-ins at 30 and 60 days.

courses.title: Private sessions with Kelly Smith
courses.description: One-hour sessions on Zoom for personal meditation or yoga instruction, teacher strategy, or coaching for podcasters and wellness professionals. A custom recorded meditation can be added.

courses.title: Worthy & Well Retreat, Bayfield, Wisconsin
courses.description: A three-day weekend for a small group at a wooded retreat above Lake Superior, co-led with writer and radio host Elizabeth Ries. Days include yoga and meditation, a walking meditation, yoga nidra with sound, a sauna and cold plunge, and seasonal local meals.

courses.title: Root, Rise & Restore Retreat, Banff
courses.description: A four-day retreat in the Canadian Rockies hosted by Kelly with Start Your ADzenTURE, combining yoga and meditation with time outdoors such as paddle boarding at Barrier Lake. Meals are included and there is a choice of shared or private rooms.

courses.title: Unplug & Reset: Reclaim Your Focus
courses.description: A five-day Insight Timer course on stepping back from constant scrolling. Each day pairs a short guided meditation and lesson with a simple screen-free task, such as a silent meal or time outdoors.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Kelly Smith on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Kelly's short guided meditations, yoga nidra and courses, in the same calm, practical style as her podcast. Free to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Mindful in Minutes podcast
free_resources.description: Kelly's long-running podcast of guided meditations of twenty minutes or less, with occasional freeform episodes and guest conversations. Free on all the main podcast apps and YouTube.

free_resources.title: Free 7-Day Meditation Challenge
free_resources.description: A week of short daily meditations for beginners, introducing different styles so you can find one that suits you and start a regular habit. Sign up by email to receive it.

flags: Health rule, unsure so plan written: her trainings, retreats and sessions are not sold on conditions, but both of her books are (You Are Not Your Thoughts is an eight-week programme to 'heal' from anxiety; Meditation for the Modern Family lists anxiety, hyperactivity and insomnia among its topics), her free Sleep Bundle targets sleepless nights and anxious evenings, and her meditation teacher training page opens with an anxiety statistic. Owner to decide whether that counts as a brand sold on conditions.
Email info@yogaforyouonline.com is the Yoga For You business inbox (published on her Private Sessions and Podcast pages); the progress lead said no email was published.

Availability set to worldwide: she calls herself location-independent and teaches online; Minneapolis comes from her Insight Timer location and her retreats are travelling events, so there is no class base.
Insight Timer course 'Unplug & Reset' is described on its page as free; the standard Member Plus price line was used per the brief.
Common name: check there is no other Kelly Smith on Spiritpedia before insert.
YouTube videos picked from the most recent uploads (the channel's view counts are low across the board); many of her titles name conditions and were skipped.
